title: Expression, Purification, and In Silico Characterization of Mycobacterium smegmatis Alternative Sigma Factor SigB.
authors: Singh, Rakesh Kumar; Jaiswal, Lav Kumar; Nayak, Tanmayee; Rawat, Ravindra Singh; Kumar, Sanjit; Rai, Sachchida Nand; Gupta, Ankush
one_liner_zh: 该文表达纯化分枝杆菌SigB因子并进行同源建模与RNAP蛋白-蛋白对接，虽涉及sigma因子与RNA聚合酶互作，但非TF-DNA结合体系，方法以实验为主、计算为辅，仅部分可借鉴。
abstract: Sigma factor B (SigB), an alternative sigma factor (ASF), is very similar to primary sigma factor SigA (sigma (70)) but dispensable for growth in both Mycobacterium smegmatis (Msmeg) and Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb). It is involved in general stress responses including heat, oxidative, surface, starvation stress, and macrophage infections. Despite having an extremely short half-life, SigB tends to operate downstream of at least three stress-responsive extra cytoplasmic function (ECF) sigma factors (SigH, SigE, SigL) and SigF involved in multiple signaling pathways. There is very little information available regarding the regulation of SigB sigma factor and its interacting protein partners. Hence, we cloned the SigB gene into pET28a vector and optimized its expression in three different strains of E. coli, viz., (BL21 (DE3), C41 (DE3), and CodonPlus (DE3)). We also optimized several other parameters for the expression of recombinant SigB including IPTG concentration, temperature, and time duration. We achieved the maximum expression of SigB at 25 degrees C in the soluble fraction of the cell which was purified by affinity chromatography using Ni-NTA and further confirmed by Western blotting. Further, structural characterization demonstrates the instability of SigB in comparison to SigA that is carried out using homology modeling and structure function relationship. We have done protein-protein docking of RNA polymerase (RNAP) of Msmeg and SigB. This effort provides a platform for pulldown assay, structural, and other studies with the recombinant protein to deduce the SigB interacting proteins, which might pave the way to study its signaling networks along with its regulation.
abstract_zh: Sigma factor B (SigB)，一种替代性sigma因子（ASF），与主要sigma因子SigA（sigma (70)）非常相似，但在耻垢分枝杆菌（Mycobacterium smegmatis, Msmeg）和结核分枝杆菌（Mycobacterium tuberculosis, Mtb）的生长中并非必需。它参与一般应激反应，包括热应激、氧化应激、表面应激、饥饿应激以及巨噬细胞感染。尽管SigB的半衰期极短，它倾向于在至少三种应激响应的外细胞功能（ECF）sigma因子（SigH、SigE、SigL）以及参与多种信号通路的SigF下游发挥作用。关于SigB sigma因子及其相互作用蛋白伙伴的调控信息非常有限。因此，我们将SigB基因克隆到pET28a载体中，并优化了其在三种不同大肠杆菌菌株（即BL21 (DE3)、C41 (DE3)和CodonPlus (DE3)）中的表达。我们还优化了重组SigB表达的其他几个参数，包括IPTG浓度、温度和时间持续时间。我们在25摄氏度下，在细胞的可溶性部分中实现了SigB的最大表达，并通过Ni-NTA亲和色谱纯化，进一步通过Western blotting确认。此外，结构表征表明，与SigA相比，SigB的不稳定性是通过同源建模和结构功能关系分析得出的。我们进行了Msmeg RNA聚合酶（RNAP）与SigB的蛋白质-蛋白质对接。这项工作为使用重组蛋白进行pull-down实验、结构研究及其他研究提供了平台，以推断SigB相互作用蛋白，这可能为研究其信号网络及其调控铺平道路。
